source: Programs and events for builders on Arc, hand-checked by stable-build contributors
license: Our own summaries (MIT) plus links and dates. Program pages keep their own terms; read them before applying.
notes: valid_until: ISO date or datetime. A date without a time is valid through the end of that day anywhere on Earth (UTC-12). valid_until_kind: deadline (last moment to submit), event-end (last day of the event), reverify (rolling program; a human must re-check by then). CI (.github/workflows/data.yml) fails once any valid_until has passed. Skills must drop expired entries and must never present a program as a promise of funding.

items.name: Arc Microgrants
items.summary: Small non-dilutive grants for projects already deployed and working on Arc mainnet: prototypes, demos, small apps and hackathon continuations.
items.amount: 500 USDC each; 20 grants from a 10,000 USDC pool
eligibility: Deployed and working on Arc mainnet when you submit, with a link reviewers can open
Short description of what it does and what it uses Arc for
Public builder profile (GitHub, X or Farcaster)
Individuals and teams worldwide, subject to sanctions screening; pseudonymous submissions allowed
not_eligible: Work already funded by a Circle or Arc program
items.notes: Reviewed on a rolling basis; earlier submissions get earlier answers. Paid in USDC on Arc, so the builder needs a wallet that can receive USDC on Arc. No equity, IP assignment or exclusivity.

items.name: Tameion Agents Hackathon
items.summary: Online hackathon for building AI agents on Arc; tagged Agent Stack and agentic economy.
eligibility: Online; register on the event page
items.notes: Event runs Sep 27 to Oct 10, 2026. The page does not state the exact submission cutoff, prizes or judging rules (UNVERIFIED); check the event page.

items.name: Arc Acceleration Season (LatAm)
items.summary: Six-week online accelerator for LatAm fintech and AI startups: onboarding, build on testnet, ship to Arc mainnet, then an online demo day.
eligibility: LatAm fintech or AI startups with an existing business
items.notes: Applications closed on 2026-09-22; the cohort runs to Oct 24. Only relevant to teams already in the cohort, or as a signal to watch for the next season.

items.name: Encode London 2026 hackathon and conference
items.summary: In-person AI and web3 hackathon plus a conference day at the Encode Hub in London.
eligibility: In person, London; register on the event page
items.notes: The page lists October 23, 2026 and describes three days of hacking, so the end date is UNVERIFIED. Whether there is an Arc track or bounty is UNVERIFIED; themes and prizes were not yet announced on 2026-10-04.

items.name: Circle Developer Grants
items.summary: Milestone-based USDC grants for teams already shipping on Arc and the Circle developer platform, with technical guidance and co-marketing.
items.amount: Tiered, milestone-based USDC funding (amounts not published)
eligibility: Arc is core to how value moves or settles in the product, with Circle products as real building blocks
Usage, pilots, partnerships or a credible path to them
items.notes: Rolling applications through the grants portal. Mainnet is not stated as a hard requirement, but traction is weighed (UNVERIFIED beyond the page text).

items.name: Arc Builders Fund (Circle Ventures)
items.summary: Teams building financial apps that depend on Arc can submit an investor deck for consideration by Circle Ventures.
eligibility: Companies with a product that relies on Arc; entry is by investor-deck submission
items.notes: The page calls it a descriptive label for a Circle Ventures internal initiative: no fund is being formed and no investors are solicited. Never describe it as a fund, an offer or an investment opportunity.

items.name: Arc Bug Bounty
items.summary: Rewards for security researchers who responsibly report vulnerabilities in Arc's chain, protocol and product surfaces.
items.amount: Up to $1 million depending on severity and impact
eligibility: Security researchers; scope and rules are on the HackerOne page (not reviewed here)
items.notes: Not funding for app builders. Amount as stated in the RFB; the HackerOne policy is UNVERIFIED here.

items.name: Arc House events hub
items.summary: Community hub for Arc hackathons, accelerators, workshops and office hours; check it for events added after this snapshot.
items.notes: Link only. Do not fetch the list page (robots.txt disallows it); open single event pages instead.
